question: According to the saved general FAQ, what credit load distinguishes full-time from part-time CDS students, and what weekly effort should a student with the prerequisites plan for each data science course?
expected_answer_points: Full-time students register for 9 credits; part-time students register for less than 9 credits.
Plan 10–15 hours per week per data science course, assuming all prerequisites are met.

evidence.quote: Full-time CDS students register for 9 credits. Part-time students register for less than 9 credits.
Students should plan on spending 10-15 hours per week per data science course, assuming they have all the prerequisites.

question: According to the saved general FAQ, how many DS-GA 1010 credits can count toward the MSDS, and which courses can be counted pass/fail? Include the exclusion and the Industry Concentration allowance.
expected_answer_points: Up to 6 credits of independent study, DS-GA 1010, can count.
Only one elective, excluding the One Data Science Elective requirement, and DS-GA 1009 may count pass/fail.
Industry Concentration students can use the one-elective allowance for an Industry Concentration elective.
Required degree courses cannot be taken pass/fail.

evidence.quote: MSDS students can apply up to 6 credits of independent study (DS-GA 1010) to the MSDS degree.

Only 1 elective (this does not include the “One Data Science Elective” requirement) and DS-GA 1009 can be taken as pass/fail and count towards the MSDS degree. Students in the Industry Concentration can use their 1 elective allowance for an Industry Concentration elective. Required courses for the degree cannot be taken as pass/fail.

question: According to the saved general FAQ, how are applicants considered for tuition scholarships, how are recipients notified, and is an on-campus research or teaching position guaranteed?
expected_answer_points: A limited number of tuition scholarships are competitive; all admission applicants are considered.
Recipients are notified in their admit letter.
On-campus positions are not guaranteed for any individual, are competitive, and typically posted semester by semester.

evidence.quote: CDS offers a limited number of tuition scholarships for our students. All applicants for admission are considered for these awards on a competitive basis. Scholarship recipients will be notified in their admit letter.

On-campus positions are available at CDS and NYU, but we do not guarantee such opportunities for any given student. Positions are competitive, and are typically posted on a semester-by-semester basis.
